digest.component_or_area: code-review verdict assembly and sidecar signing
propositions: Code-review verdicts never record the provider_provenance key, even though the sidecar reads it at sidecar.py:106, leaving verdicts without provider, endpoint host, and support tier attribution.

The code-review verdict assembly path (code_review_coach and finalize_code_review_verdict) omits provider_provenance while plan-review and completion gates include it via the same mechanism (343b gap 5 fix).
The provider_provenance record must be threaded from the Pass-2 verify agent step's runner output through to the terminal verdict, without recomputation or derivation from config.
The degraded/outage code-review verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than synthesizing one from config when no model ran.
Code-review.yaml must wire provider_provenance from an AGENT step (verify), not a scripted op, to preserve the runner result verbatim and prevent silent divergence from the actual record.
